stories.title: AL West Final Weekend — Astros, Rangers Both at 79-81 After Friday Collapses

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
BOTH teams lost Friday.

Rangers: 10-2 L to Minnesota (deGrom allowed 8 ER)
Astros: 6-5 L at Oakland

Both at 79-81. Two games left. Houston holds the tiebreaker.

The winner of the AL West could have a losing record. That has NEVER happened. #MLB #ALWest

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The Rangers need to win AND the Astros need to lose just to force anything.

Houston's tiebreaker means that even if both teams finish tied, it goes to the Astros.

Texas is running out of room. Saturday at 3:10 PM. #Rangers #Astros #ALWest

article.headline: AL West Final Weekend: Astros and Rangers Both 79-81 After Friday Collapses — History in the Balance

stories.title: Yordan Alvarez Triple Crown Chase — Final Weekend, History on the Line

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Yordan Alvarez enters the final weekend:

.311 batting average
40 home runs
102 RBI

One problem: Junior Caminero (Rays) has 41 HR — leading Alvarez in that category.

Last AL Triple Crown: Cabrera, 2012. No Astros player has ever done it. #Astros #MLB

article.headline: Yordan Alvarez's Triple Crown Chase Comes Down to the Final Weekend — and Junior Caminero Has the Lead in HRs

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
AL Central title race — two games left:

Guardians: 1 game up
White Sox: hold the tiebreaker

Both teams have already clinched the playoffs. But which one gets the No. 2 seed matters.

If they finish tied → White Sox win the division. Cleveland needs a lead to keep it. #MLB

stories.title: Aaron Judge Update — Yankees Planning Without Slugger for Red Sox Wild Card Series

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Aaron Boone on Judge for the Wild Card Series vs. the Red Sox:

"We're planning on him not being a part of that."

Judge himself: "I'm not giving up."

Yankees gave him a PPP injection Monday. The soleus calf strain is the complicating factor. The finale is Sept. 27. #Yankees

article.headline: Yankees Are 'Planning' Without Aaron Judge for Wild Card Series — But Judge Isn't Done Fighting

stories.title: NL Final Weekend — Phillies vs. D-backs, One Spot Left, D-backs Hold Tiebreaker

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
One NL playoff spot left.

Phillies: 86-70 (magic number: 2)
D-backs: 81-74 (hold tiebreaker)

Philadelphia is in the driver's seat. But they need to be 1 game better because Arizona has the tiebreaker.

Six games left. One spot available. #MLB #Phillies #Dbacks
